turns.q: Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
tructured tops like tucked-in blouses, knit tops, or cropped sweaters, plus ankle boots, block heels, or platform sneakers
Flare jeans: fitted tees or tanks, tucked-in blouses, cropped jackets, or structured blazers
Boyfriend jeans: tucked-in tees, slim sweaters, or bodysuits with a structured blazer, plus sneakers, flats, or heels
In general, the best styling trick is balancing the shape of the jeans with a more fitted or structured top to define your waist and keep the look polished.
